_how_to_use: 1. Run `node scripts/export_catalog.mjs` to get catalog.json pre-filled with what is live today.
2. Fill it in using this file as the field reference. Copy a block below to add a new course.
3. Run `node scripts/import_catalog.mjs` (dry run) until it reports 0 errors.
Every value is a DB column. null means 'not set'. Keys ending in _es are the Spanish copy.
Rows match on masterclasses.title and chapters.slug — change either one and you create a NEW row.

masterclasses.title: REQUIRED — English course name. This is the match key; renaming creates a new course.
masterclasses.subtitle: One line under the title on the card. Optional.
masterclasses.description: REQUIRED to publish — 2–4 sentences: what the student learns and walks away with.
masterclasses.title_es: REQUERIDO — nombre del curso en español.
masterclasses.thumbnail_url: REQUIRED to publish — public URL of the 16:9 card image (upload via the admin console or Supabase Storage `vault-assets`).
masterclasses.video_url: Optional free teaser: a Vimeo URL or bare id, e.g. https://vimeo.com/1207933620. Anything else and no teaser renders.
masterclasses.price_display: REQUIRED to publish — the string shown on the card, e.g. "$50". Must match the Stripe price; nothing computes it.
masterclasses.stripe_product_id: REQUIRED to publish — prod_… from Stripe. This is what the webhook resolves to grant access.
masterclasses.price_id: REQUIRED to publish — price_… from Stripe. This is what Checkout charges.

modules.slug: REQUIRED-lowercase-kebab-case — the URL segment, and the match key. Never change it after launch; links and progress rows point at it.
modules.title: REQUIRED — module title.
modules.description: REQUIRED to publish — what this module covers.
modules.video_id: REQUIRED (NOT NULL) — the English Vimeo id, digits only, e.g. 1207933620. Use "pending_video" only while is_published is false.
modules.video_id_es: Spanish Vimeo id, or null to fall back to the English video.
takeaways: Bullet shown on the module page — one short line per learning point.
takeaways_es: Mismo punto, en español. Si el array está vacío se muestra el inglés.

lab_questions.label: The question as the student reads it. REQUIRED — the Lab renders `label`, not `question`.
lab_questions.placeholder: Example answer shown greyed out in the field.

standalone_courses.title: REQUIRED — a course that is not part of any masterclass (one page, one video).
standalone_courses.thumbnail_url: REQUIRED to publish — a standalone course is its own catalog card.
standalone_courses.stripe_product_id: prod_… if it can be bought on its own; null if it is Full-Access-only.
standalone_courses.price_id: price_… paired with the product above.
